🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
CAUTION. Breadth: 10/11 sectors positive; confirmation: broad sector strength (10/11 sectors) contrasted with concentrated Tech weakness (many large-cap Tech names BELOW TREND), producing mixed signals. Leadership is broad at the top but major-cap divergences justify caution.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Consumer Staples lead: WMT ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.70% | 1M: +11.26%), KO not in detailed list but sector strength visible. Energy strong: COP ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.25% | 1M: +10.00%), XOM ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.94% | 1M: +9.62%). Healthcare strong: LLY ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.59% | 1M: +9.08%), UNH ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.83% | 1M: +6.99%).

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Technology lagging: Tech: 6/24 positive (estimated) with NVDA BELOW TREND (1W: -6.61% | 1M: -2.38%), MSFT CORRECTION (1W: -1.13% | 1M: +6.29%), GOOGL BELOW TREND (1W: -3.15% | 1M: -1.94%). Industrials mixed/soft: CAT BELOW TREND (1W: -8.71% | 1M: -8.49%), LMT ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.34% | 1M: +2.60%). Communication mixed: VZ RECOVERY (1W: +7.54% | 1M: -5.89%), TMUS RECOVERY (1W: +7.08% | 1M: -4.42%).

📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: ACN ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.74% | 1M: +21.67%), COP ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.25% | 1M: +10.00%), LMT ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.34% | 1M: +2.60%), VZ RECOVERY (1W: +7.54% | 1M: -5.89%), SBUX ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.46% | 1M: +0.88%). Leadership: Broad (5 sectors in Top 5).

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: AMAT BELOW TREND (1W: -19.28% | 1M: -1.94%), PANW BELOW TREND (1W: -18.33% | 1M: -8.81%), LRCX BELOW TREND (1W: -17.22% | 1M: -1.89%), INTC BELOW TREND (1W: -14.18% | 1M: -17.42%), AMD BELOW TREND (1W: -13.05% | 1M: -3.00%). Leadership: Narrow (5/5 Technology) — concentrated weakness.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Best 1W movers: ACN (1W: +10.74%), COP (1W: +9.25%), LMT (1W: +8.34%), VZ (1W: +7.54%), SBUX (1W: +7.46%). There is a MAJOR divergence (≥3 large caps with conflicting 1W vs 1M signs — e.g., VZ, TMUS RECOVERY; MSFT CORRECTION); treat moves as tactical until confirmed.

🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Tech weak with concentrated selling; Tech: 6/24 positive (estimated). AAPL ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.03% | 1M: +1.92%), MSFT CORRECTION (1W: -1.13% | 1M: +6.29%), NVDA BELOW TREND (1W: -6.61% | 1M: -2.38%), AVGO BELOW TREND (1W: -9.07% | 1M: -5.17%), ORCL BELOW TREND (1W: -9.31% | 1M: -14.53%).

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials steady but not leading aggressively; Financials: 14/20 positive (estimated). V ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.45% | 1M: +8.83%), MA ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.80% | 1M: +9.30%), JPM RECOVERY (1W: +2.02% | 1M: -2.26%) — rotation into pockets of value/cyclicals rather than clear broad Financial leadership.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare constructive: Healthcare: 15/17 positive (estimated). LLY ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.59% | 1M: +9.08%), UNH ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.83% | 1M: +6.99%), JNJ BELOW TREND (1W: -2.25% | 1M: -5.43%) shows a sentiment/price divergence despite bullish headlines.

🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor selective exposure to Energy/Healthcare/Consumer Staples and quality Industrials while reducing exposure to large-cap semiconductors and cyclical Tech names showing BELOW TREND stress. Style: mixed / no clear leadership — remain tactical and size positions with caution given the major-cap divergences.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: ACN ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.74% | 1M: +21.67%), LLY ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.59% | 1M: +9.08%), COP ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.25% | 1M: +10.00%). BEARISH: AMAT BELOW TREND (1W: -19.28% | 1M: -1.94%), NVDA BELOW TREND (1W: -6.61% | 1M: -2.38%), INTC BELOW TREND (1W: -14.18% | 1M: -17.42%).

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Energy (Energy: 8/10 positive estimated) and Healthcare (Healthcare: 15/17 positive estimated) on strong 1W flows. BEARISH: Technology (Tech: 6/24 positive estimated) — watch semiconductor group for continued dispersion.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
NVDA: watch for failure to reclaim recent 1W range to confirm ongoing BELOW TREND risk. AAPL: hold above recent 1M trend (ABOVE TREND confirmation) for Tech stability. ACN: success staying above the recent breakout would signal continuation. JPM: follow-through above this week's RECOVERY leg to confirm Financials rotation.

📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
JNJ (+75): JNJ ABOVE/BEAR? JNJ is BELOW TREND (1W: -2.25% | 1M: -5.43%) — bullish guidance but price not confirming (divergence). LLY (+75): LLY ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.59% | 1M: +9.08%) — sentiment confirmed by price. XOM (+55): XOM ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.94% | 1M: +9.62%) — sentiment and price aligned.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
MSFT (-50): MSFT CORRECTION (1W: -1.13% | 1M: +6.29%) — negative headlines aligning with near-term weakness (watch for follow-through). INTC (-50): INTC BELOW TREND (1W: -14.18% | 1M: -17.42%) — sentiment confirmed. BA (-50): BA BELOW TREND (1W: -0.08% | 1M: -3.45%) — negative news consistent with ongoing pressure.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION, style mixed / no clear leadership. LLY ABOVE TREND, ACN ABOVE TREND and COP ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength while NVDA, INTC and a cluster of semiconductors remain BELOW TREND. Key risk: concentrated Tech weakness and several major-cap sentiment/price divergences — watch for trend breaks before expanding exposure.
